desc: Derive the formula for \(\sum_j |a-B_j|\) using counts and sums of \(B_j<a\) and \(B_j\ge a\).
Reject the naïve per-\(A_i\) persistent-query approach as the sole method and select sqrt decomposition for the A-prefix dimension.
Implement persistent segment tree versions for B prefixes, storing counts and value sums and supporting absolute-difference queries for one \(A_i\) against \(B_1,\ldots,B_Y\).

Implement block-boundary processing: incrementally merge each A block into a sorted boundary list, compute all boundary-prefix interactions with B in \(O(N)\) using globally sorted B values, and answer grouped queries.
Combine boundary answers with leftover A-element contributions, preserving original query order.
Correct the `less_than` query’s final-leaf inclusion bug.
Verify both samples, 64-bit bounds, time/memory complexity, input parsing, and output formatting.
